description: Purge Desk Data. Use this to wipe records for a specific sender domain or permanently delete your entire desk and all associated history.

desk_key.description: The secret desk_key returned when the desk was created. It is the only credential for this desk and cannot be recovered.

scope.description: Whether to wipe the entire desk or records for a specific sender domain.

sender_domain.description: Required if scope is 'sender': the domain name to delete.

name: purge_data
title: Purge Desk Data
